title: FE Player gui KEYLESS
features:
Credits : ghostplayer YT

✅ Player Search – Instantly find any player by typing their name.
✅ ESP – Highlight the selected player to track them easily (Note: ESP will not work if the player is too far away).
✅ View Player – Spectate the selected player in real-time.
✅ Teleport – Instantly teleport to the chosen player.
✅ Fling – Send the player flying with a single click.
✅ More Features – Additional tools for better player control!

⚠️ Reminder:
If the player gets disconnected while their name is searched, no features will work, but the player's name will still be displayed.
